question: What is the meaning of refurbishment in relation to treatment facilities information?
description: Refurbishment in relation to treatment facilities information refers to the process of updating or renovating the existing facilities to improve their functionality, efficiency, or aesthetics. This can involve repairing, replacing, or upgrading components of the treatment facilities to ensure they continue to operate effectively and meet the required standards.
